implementation: SUSE Linux Enterprise - OpenSSL FIPS Provider (SSH_CPACF)
description: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP6 OpenSSL FIPS provider implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: SSH KDF using CPACF SHA implementation.
